description: Collect the API key the user approved after `request_api_key`. Returns the public key (`apikey`, pk1_...) and the secret key (`secretapikey`, sk1_...) exactly once; store them securely right away (for example as PORKBUN_API_KEY / PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY in the MCP server's config, never in a committed file). Until the user approves, the answer says the request is still pending: wait and try again. This server keeps using the credentials it was started with; to switch to the new key, update its configuration and restart or reconnect it.
name: retrieve_api_key
title: Retrieve API Key
